text_to_image_prompt: Create one chest-up portrait of a fictional adult woman aged 22–28 in premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D romance-game CG style. The face is upright and strictly frontal, eyes on a level horizontal line, centered nose, mouth and chin, level shoulders, balanced left and right cheek volume. Muted pink cotton T-shirt with a fine faded botanical print, open cream knit cardigan with a small tan button, delicate silver chain with a small round pendant. Gentle attentive neutral adult expression. Opaque pure white seamless background, soft neutral frontal studio lighting and generous fill, bright low-shadow exposure. Sculpted dimensional facial shading, subtle skin microtexture, detailed individually groomed hair strands and visible knit texture, low oily sheen, graceful CG realism. Complete hair inside frame, shoulders and upper chest visible, no hands, no text, watermark, border or collage. Vertical 3:4 composition, target canvas 1086 × 1448 pixels.
